title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Definition: Repair-Period Share of a Customer-Pay Rental
content:
**Definition.** The repair-period share limits the repair-customer discount on a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network customer-pay repair to the rental days of the repair period; the discount is given on that share of the discount base. Where the repaired vehicle was released and the rental was returned after the release date, the share is the rental days that start on or before the release date divided by all rental days; where the repaired vehicle has not been released but the repair is ready, the share is the rental days that start on or before the ready date divided by all rental days; otherwise the share is one. Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.

## Records read

The release (delivered) date and the ready date of the repair order under Customer-Pay Repairs the rental is tied to, and the pickup and return dates and times of the reservation.

## Rental days that start on or before a date

The first rental day starts on the pickup date and each later rental day starts one calendar day after the one before. The rental days starting on or before a given date are therefore the whole days from the pickup date to that date, plus one, and never more than all rental days.

## Share table

| Repair order shows | Rental returned after the release date | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Released | Yes | Rental days starting on or before the release date, divided by all rental days |
| Released | No | One |
| Not released, ready | Not applicable | Rental days starting on or before the ready date, divided by all rental days |
| Neither released nor ready | Not applicable | One |

## Worked share (hypothetical dates)

A rental picked up on the 2nd at 08:00 and returned on the 12th at 09:00 has 11 rental days. The repaired vehicle was released on the 9th: the rental days starting on or before the 9th are 8, so the share is 8 divided by 11. Had the vehicle been released on the 12th, the return date would not be after the release date and the share would be one.
